title: Certify P104 dependency obstruction for every fixed-pair flag completion
body:
## Summary

PR2981's static endpoint matching cannot become an X-only monotone correction by changing intermediate bases. A sound optimistic contact graph leaves 3,095 of 4,992 required coefficients unreachable, including `X4 -> Y0`, which needs `-1/2` but is forced to zero.

```text
208 fixed endpoint pairs from PR2981
  -> permit every intermediate flag completion
  -> grant all possible untimed common-frame contacts
  -> 3,095 required dependencies still have no path
```

Adds one isolated source-pinned package, `research/p104-endpoint-completion-flow`, with a written support-invariant proof, interval-based checker, independent literal quotient-subspace enumeration, full receipt and replay controls. Credit PR2981/2920 and the retained P104 contributors named in the package.

This complements the [concurrent exact-full-flag audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18977808). It covers every intermediate completion of the same fixed endpoint pairs. Other matchings, extra lifetimes and changed access contracts remain open. No new lifetime floor, supplier or kappa is claimed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR2981 certifies static joint endpoint coverage; its source-acquisition implication remains open.
  **After:** two separately implemented source-bound checks agree on every target support mask, contact count and missing-coefficient witness. The independent checker enumerates all 374 subspaces of each five-dimensional endpoint quotient and traces each source separately.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay passes. Six behavioral groups cover every tiny binary subspace interval, relay/direct access, backward-flow rejection, changed intermediate bases, actual optimized CLIs, Git-free exports, source corruption and receipt/schema faults. Optimized CPython 3.14.8 checks, Ruff, warning-as-error compilation and committed-byte preflight also pass locally.
- Reproduce: `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-endpoint-completion-flow`.
- [Canonical claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2245#discussioncomment-18977898). Started from current canonical main `836b19bfa309ceafbc8ee32a15e8c4b10dde7e11`, priority revision 6; refreshed main and live overlap before submission. Internal review found no substantive defect. Hosted CI and independent human/formal review are separate.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way.

**Blast Radius:** Package.

The opt-in package adds a scoped obstruction and verification commands. Frozen predecessors, shared verification code and the selected frontier are unchanged. This is a written scoped proof with finite source checks; native implementation, complete physical costs and all-size supplier admission are outside its claim.
